verdict.rationale: Working Copy's AI features (Code Agent and commit-message suggestions) are opt-in, so a user can keep repository data from going to an AI provider at all; the docs note that suggestions send staged diffs to OpenAI. Nothing in the pack addresses whether data that is sent may be used for model training. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or setting on AI training use, OpenAI data-retention and training terms for the diffs sent, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Code Agent & commit suggestions. Respects your data with opt-in.
These AI suggestions require sending staged differences to OpenAI
